title: The real work starts when the agent says "I'm done"
excerpt: An AI agent tells you it's done. How do you know it's true? What I've learned building UXMachine, and a few questions to check your agent's work even if you're not a programmer.
seo_title: Checking what an AI agent did: the work loop
seo_description: An agent saying "I'm done" proves nothing. What it takes to check its work from the outside, and why it can't correct itself.
alt: An AI agent holds up a sheet with a tick while a hand checks another sheet with a magnifying glass and finds an error.
